title: caopia obtusa
intro: Caopia obtusa, commonly known as the Chinese parasol or varnish tree, is a species of plant in the family Anacardiaceae. It is traditionally used in medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and sore throat, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activity. The bioactive constituents of Caopia obtusa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
